project_title: AI-Based Intelligent Retrieval and Quality-Aware Curation of Scientific Microscopy Images

RQ1.title: Acquisition-Robust Retrieval (Protocol M vs. Protocol U)
RQ1.description: Does supervised contrastive acquisition adaptation compress the cross-instrument embedding gap under Unmatched Acquisition conditions (Protocol U) without degrading fine-grained intra-acquisition discriminability under Matched Acquisition conditions (Protocol M)?

RQ2.title: Computational Quality-Risk Screening
RQ2.description: Can image-derived quality indicators (Laplacian focus variance, saturation/dark clipping, Shannon entropy, dynamic range) reliably flag compromised micrographs without relying on proprietary microscope hardware telemetry?

RQ3.title: Spatial Localization & Principled Uncertainty Abstention
RQ3.description: Can model-derived suspicious region localization combined with entropy- and margin-based uncertainty estimation identify corrupted regions and trigger reliable automated abstention?

RQ4.title: Grounded Evidence Retrieval & Suggested Corrective Action
RQ4.description: Does retrieving comparable cross-acquisition reference micrographs (N=55 cohort context) enable deterministic mapping to actionable microscope operational parameter adjustments?

RQ5.title: Human-in-the-Loop Scientific Curation
RQ5.description: Does integrating quality-risk triage, localization overlays, and grounded evidence into a unified curation workbench reduce human inspection fatigue while preserving scientific data integrity?

computational_quality_screening.nature_of_indicators: Computational heuristics derived strictly from pixel intensity distributions; NO hardware telemetry

spatial_localization.label: Model-Derived Suspicious Region
spatial_localization.disclaimer: Computational spatial anomaly heuristic; not a confirmed physical defect

uncertainty_and_abstention.abstention_action: Defer to human microscopy specialist for mandatory verification

evidence_and_action_mapping.mapping_determinism: 100% deterministic rule-based catalog; no free-form hallucination

test_suite_reconciliation.reconciliation_explanation: Historical reports documented 218 tests prior to the addition of Phase 5 evidence and explanation tests, Phase 6 integrated validation tests, Phase 7-9 closure suites, and Phase 10 platform closure and canonical workflow tests. Current live test suite comprises exactly 479 passed tests.
